name: MOMENT_EQUALITY_OBFUSCATION
description: Replaced the explicit exclusion of double-selection with an equality between the first and second moments (sum of amplitudes vs sum of squared amplitudes). By omitting the explicit statement that amplitudes are bounded to {0, 1, 2}, models are less likely to recognize the boolean nature of the problem. They must mathematically deduce that since amplitudes are in {0, 1, 2}, the equality sum(A) = sum(A^2) holds if and only if no amplitude is 2, which exactly enforces the independent set constraint.
